issues.label: 1a, 3a, 5a, 7a, 9a
issues.detail: Model answers for these questions list military service (1a), jury service (3a, 5a, 7a, 9a) as third duty, but questions 4a, 6a, 8a, 10a list taxes instead. No explanation for variation or curriculum basis provided.
issues.correction: Verify Rwanda S5 curriculum specification for third duty. Standardize across all instances with textbook citation.

review.summary: Assessment contains 29 questions across 10 near-identical sets addressing national duties/obligations. Critical issue: inconsistent model answers for identical questions (duties listed vary across sets). Redundant structure lacks progressive complexity. Requires consolidation and verification against Rwanda GENERAL EDU-History-S5-SB source material.
